description: This file defines a database migration class for version 4.0 of the OrangeHRM system. It creates new database tables and menu configurations related to employee events and OAuth client registration.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A migration class extending AbstractMigration to handle schema changes for version 4.0, including creating tables and inserting menu items.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Executes the migration by creating a new table 'ohrm_employee_event', and adding menu items for OAuth client registration, including fetching related menu IDs and setting up the hierarchy.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version identifier '4.0' for this migration.
